payload.title: Best Time to Get Married in Greece by Month
payload.excerpt: No single month suits every Greek wedding. The months that work for you depend on four things: the island, how well your guests cope with heat, whether you want a church ceremony, and how long everyone will stay.
key_takeaways: June to August is the hot, dry core at the Naxos, Heraklion, Chania Souda and Rodos stations, with Kerkyra the wetter exception, while May and October are milder with more rain and September keeps summer warmth with fewer rain days than October.
Smartraveller warns that summer heatwaves are frequent in Greece and that wildfires occur from June to September, so high-summer weddings need shade, water and evening timing.
Venues set their own season windows, and some spaces open for less of the year than the weather allows.
The Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of Australia lists dates when marriages are not permitted, including Great Lent to Easter Sunday and 1 to 15 August.

faq.q: When do Greek venues open for weddings?
faq.a: Each venue sets its own season. At Angsana Corfu, for example, Oribu Garden opens in April and Vertigo Sky Bar from mid-May. Minos Palace describes eastern Crete as pleasant from April to November.

faq.q: How hot is Greece in July and August?
faq.a: It depends on the island. Average maximums run from about 27°C at Naxos to 31.5°C at Kerkyra in August. As at November 2026, Smartraveller says heatwaves are frequent over the summer months and advises water, a hat, light clothing and shade or air-conditioning.

faq.q: Can we marry in a Greek Orthodox church at any time of year?
faq.a: No. The Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of Australia lists closed dates including Great Lent to Easter Sunday, 1 to 15 August, 29 August and 14 September. For a church wedding in Greece, ask your priest and the local Metropolis.

faq.q: Is October too late for a Greek island wedding?
faq.a: Not necessarily, but plan for rain. October maximums average 21.9°C at Naxos and 24.5°C at Rodos, with rain days rising to 5.5 and 6.5, and to 11.4 at Kerkyra. At Angsana Corfu, Oribu Garden and Oribu Restaurant still take October weddings, so ask your venue about covered spaces.
